title_en: Opinions of the Supreme People's Court on Cultivating and Practicing Socialist Core Values in the Work of People's Courts
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Several Opinions on Cultivating and Practicing Socialist Core Values in the Work of People's Courts

Fa Fa [2015] No. 14

To implement the "Opinions on Cultivating and Practicing Socialist Core Values" of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the systematic expositions of General Secretary Xi Jinping on cultivating and practicing socialist core values, to strengthen the cultivation and practice of socialist core values in the work of people's courts, to strive to achieve the value goals of prosperity, democracy, civilization, and harmony, to pursue the value orientation of freedom, equality, justice, and the rule of law, to practice the value criteria of patriotism, dedication, integrity, and friendship, to vigorously strengthen the construction of judicial ethics, to ensure that judges correctly perform their duties under the Constitution and laws, and to promote the continuous improvement of the level of construction of socialist core values throughout society, these Opinions are formulated in accordance with the "Constitution of the People's Republic of China," the "Judges Law of the People's Republic of China," and relevant provisions.

In cultivating and practicing socialist core values in the people's courts, it is necessary to hold high the great banner of socialism with Chinese characteristics and to always adhere to the leadership of the Party. Party leadership is the most essential feature and the most fundamental political guarantee of the rule of law with Chinese characteristics, and it is also the fundamental guarantee for cultivating and practicing socialist core values. Judges and other court staff must maintain a high degree of consistency with the Party Central Committee with Comrade Xi Jinping as the core in thought and action, ensuring that all policies of the Party Central Committee are implemented without compromise in adjudication, enforcement, and other work. All work of the people's courts must always adhere to Party leadership and be committed to consolidating the Party's ruling position. All Party members, especially leading officials, must play an exemplary and leading role in cultivating and practicing socialist core values.

1. Adhere to Judicial Service for the People. Firmly establish the concept that the people's character is the fundamental attribute of the people's judiciary, and strive to achieve the purpose of serving the people, relying on the people, benefiting the people, and protecting the people in judicial work. The people are the direct beneficiaries and ultimate judges of the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of adjudication and enforcement work. Judicial credibility and its dignity and authority ultimately rest on the reputation among the people. The goal and fundamental task of the people's judiciary shall be to adjudicate and enforce all types of cases justly and efficiently, to resolve various social conflicts to the greatest extent, and to protect the legitimate rights and interests of the people in accordance with the law. In accordance with the requirement that "the people's aspiration for a better life is our goal," channels for the people to safeguard their rights according to law shall be unblocked, the concerns and expectations of the people for fair justice shall be actively responded to, and high-quality and efficient judicial services shall be provided for the people to participate in litigation. Convenient and people-benefiting measures or facilities such as litigation service centers, petition halls, circuit trials, online platforms, and service hotlines shall be improved to make justice convenient and accessible to the people and to allow the people to enter the judiciary. Various good experiences and practices of serving the people judicially shall be continuously summarized and promoted, modern information technology shall be fully utilized, and within the scope of the law and policies, the convenience, benefit, and closeness to the people of the judiciary shall be reflected in every link of adjudication and enforcement work.

2. Be Loyal to the Constitution and Laws. The Constitution and laws embody the propositions of the Party and the common will of the people, are the basic code of conduct to be jointly observed by all citizens, all political parties, and all social organizations, are the institutional achievements and spiritual wealth jointly created by the Chinese nation in the great practice of building a socialist country under the rule of law, and are also the fundamental basis for the people's courts to exercise their powers and perform their duties. Loyalty to the Constitution and laws is an important aspect of loyalty to the Party and the people, and defending the dignity of the Constitution and laws is a concentrated manifestation of upholding the authority of the Party and the people. All judges and other court staff shall sincerely support and have inner faith in the Constitution and laws, take the lead in observing and obeying the Constitution and laws, and strictly, correctly, and justly implement the Constitution and laws. The important role of the judiciary in promoting the construction of a country under the rule of law and the development of a society under the rule of law shall be fully utilized. All judicial activities, such as adjudicating and enforcing various types of cases, formulating judicial policies, issuing judicial interpretations, and publishing guiding cases, must be loyal to the content and spirit of the Constitution and laws, strictly implement the provisions and requirements of the Constitution and laws, resolutely uphold the dignity and authority of the Constitution and laws, and resolutely implement the decisions and deployments of the Party Central Committee on governing the country according to the Constitution and the law.

3. Respect and Protect Human Rights. Resolutely implement the various provisions of the Constitution and laws on respecting and protecting human rights, and always regard respecting and protecting human rights as the basic duty and task of the people's courts. The function of the judiciary in protecting human rights shall be maximized, adhering to the unity of protecting individual human rights and collective human rights, citizens' political rights and economic, social, and cultural rights, the rights of the majority and the rights of minorities, and paying more attention to the use of judicial means to protect citizens' right to development and environmental rights and interests. In adjudication and enforcement work, for cases that the people's court should accept according to law, it must be ensured that cases are filed as required and complaints are handled as required, effectively protecting the litigant rights of the parties. The litigation rights of the parties and other litigation participants, such as the right to know, the right to make statements, the right to defense, the right to agency, the right to apply, and the right to appeal, shall be protected according to law, and judicial powers shall not be abused to restrict, deprive, or covertly restrict or deprive them. Judicial protection of the human rights of women, minors, and the elderly shall be strengthened, and efforts shall be actively made to continuously increase the intensity of judicial remedies for human rights. Legal principles and systems such as the principle of no punishment without law, the principle of presuming innocence when in doubt, and the exclusion of illegally obtained evidence shall be resolutely implemented, mechanisms for effectively preventing and promptly correcting miscarriages of justice shall be improved, and efforts shall be made to improve the effect and level of judicial protection of human rights.

4. Adhere to Equal Protection. Attach great importance to the people's eager expectation for equality, carefully study and judge inequality phenomena and the hidden social risks, lawfully adjudicate lawsuits filed by parties against illegal unequal treatment, dare to confront various unequal phenomena and practices that violate the law and have no legal basis, actively resolve conflicts and contradictions arising from social inequality, promote social stability and harmony, and promote the continuous realization of equality in development. It shall be effectively ensured that the principle of equality before the law is implemented in judicial activities, and efforts shall be made to create equal conditions and mechanisms for the realization of litigant rights for all parties. In criminal, civil, and administrative litigation activities, it shall be ensured that no citizen is subject to unequal treatment before the law due to differences in ethnicity, race, gender, occupation, family background, religious belief, education level, property status, or length of residence. In the execution of penalties, decisions on commutation of sentences, parole, and temporary service of sentence outside prison, strict adherence to the law shall be maintained, and no one shall be allowed to enjoy special privileges outside the law. In the adjudication and enforcement of foreign-related cases, the legitimate rights and interests of Chinese and foreign parties shall be protected equally.

5. Uphold Fairness and Justice. Justice is the lifeline of the rule of law and the cornerstone of judicial credibility and judicial authority. Judicial conduct shall be standardized through strict justice, the discretion shall be exercised prudently, and fair justice shall be ensured. Equal emphasis shall be placed on substantive justice and procedural justice. In handling various litigation cases, it must be resolutely ensured that the facts are clearly found, the law is correctly applied, the judgment result is fair, the trial procedure is lawful, the reasoning is sufficient, and the legal documents are standardized. Judicial openness shall be used to promote and ensure judicial fairness, so that judicial fairness is achieved in a way visible to the people, the acceptability and recognition of judicial judgments shall be effectively enhanced, and efforts shall be made to enable the people to feel fairness and justice in every judicial case. The leading role of judicial fairness in social fairness shall be fully utilized, and injustice in judicial fairness that harms social fairness shall be resolutely avoided, ensuring the realization of fairness and justice throughout society. Acts of contempt for the authority of the court and hindrance of the people's court's adjudication and enforcement activities in fair justice and maintaining social fairness and justice shall be punished according to law, and efforts to crack down on criminal acts of refusing to comply with effective judgments and orders shall be increased, so that fair judgments are enforced and the winning party enjoys the fruits of fairness and justice.

6. Promote the Spirit of the Rule of Law. Promoting the spirit of the rule of law throughout society is an important part of comprehensively advancing the rule of law. Adjudication and enforcement work is an important way to promote the spirit of the rule of law. The case handling process shall be regarded as a process of promoting the concept of the rule of law and promoting the spirit of the rule of law. Through strict and fair justice, various entities shall be guided to comply with economic and social order and legal rules, promoting a healthy social atmosphere of respecting, learning, using, abiding by, and believing in the law. Various acts that destroy legal rules shall be severely sanctioned, and social habits of talking about rules, observing rules, believing in rules, and acting according to rules shall be cultivated with vivid cases, effectively establishing the dignity and authority of the law. Opportunities and conditions shall be created for the public to attend court hearings, understand court work, participate in judicial activities, and receive legal education, so that citizens entering the court, attending hearings, and participating in the judiciary become a bright landscape of a society under the rule of law. Through methods such as publishing statistical data, live broadcasting court proceedings, publishing judgment documents, and issuing typical cases, the achievements of socialist rule of law shall be vigorously publicized, the spirit of socialist rule of law shall be promoted, socialist rule of law culture shall be cultivated, and a social atmosphere shall be promoted where everyone exercises rights according to law, safeguards rights according to law, consciously fulfills obligations, and considers abiding by the law as glorious and violating the law as shameful.

7. Safeguard Public Interests. Public interests are related to the vital interests, common well-being, and overall interests of the people. Protecting public interests and continuously enhancing public interests are essential characteristics and great advantages of the socialist system. Advocating that personal interests be subordinate to public interests is an important part of socialist morality. The judicial function shall be fully utilized to implement the provisions of the Constitution and laws on safeguarding public interests, and crimes endangering national security that seriously endanger national sovereignty and territorial integrity shall be severely punished according to law to defend national sovereignty and territorial integrity. Crimes endangering public security and social stability such as violent and terrorist activities, crimes of mafia-type organizations, and crimes that seriously endanger public order shall be severely punished according to law to ensure the people of all ethnic groups live and work in peace and contentment. Illegal and criminal cases that infringe upon the legitimate rights and interests of the people or harm social public interests, such as destroying land and mineral resources, polluting the ecological environment, endangering food and drug safety, producing and selling counterfeit and shoddy products, and embezzling state assets, shall be severely punished according to law, effectively protecting the people's ecological and environmental rights and common vital interests. The judicial function shall be fully utilized to correctly handle the relationship between public interests and individual rights, promoting the formation of legal awareness and moral standards throughout society that consciously safeguard public interests under socialism.

8. Promote Clean Government Construction. Judicial integrity is an important aspect and a strong starting point for clean government construction. All judges and other court staff must strengthen their ideals and beliefs, adhere to professional ethics, cherish judicial honor, abide by integrity and honesty, ensure judicial fairness with judicial integrity, establish judicial authority, improve judicial credibility, promote political clarity, purify social atmosphere, and lead social trends. It must be clearly recognized that adjudication and enforcement powers have become key areas targeted by lawsuit brokers, and the bottom line of integrity and self-discipline must be firmly maintained, various hidden corruption rules must be completely eradicated, and relationship cases, favor cases, and money cases must be resolutely eliminated to effectively protect the reputation and image of the judiciary. Improper contacts, interactions, and transfers of benefits with parties, lawyers, special related persons, and intermediary organizations must be resolutely eliminated, and systems and regulations such as judge recusal for conflicts of interest, full record of inquiries about cases, and prevention of conflicts of interest must be strictly implemented. Judicial openness shall be used to promote judicial integrity, leaving no place for judicial corruption to hide in the sunshine. The "five prohibitions" regulations must be strictly implemented, illegal and criminal acts of court staff must be severely punished according to law, the black sheep in the team must be resolutely eliminated, the requirement of a lifetime ban on judicial personnel who have been dismissed from public office for illegal or criminal acts must be resolutely implemented, zero tolerance for judicial corruption must be adhered to, and judicial integrity and honesty shall be guaranteed from an institutional perspective.

9. Encourage Honesty and Trustworthiness. Honesty and trustworthiness are basic values universally advocated in human society. The principle of good faith is recognized as the fundamental principle of civil and commercial activities. The construction of a trustworthy society shall be promoted by advocating litigation integrity. In adjudication and enforcement activities, in addition to ascertaining the substantive disputes and the rights and wrongs of the case, judicial personnel must also review the honesty and trustworthiness of the parties during the occurrence of the dispute and the litigation process and use it as an important basis for judgment. Honest and trustworthy parties shall be protected and encouraged according to law, so that honest parties do not suffer losses in litigation; dishonest parties shall be sanctioned and condemned according to law, so that cunning and untrustworthy persons do not gain advantages through litigation. Various malicious lawsuits and false lawsuits initiated for illegal purposes, fabricating facts to file lawsuits or abusing litigation rights, intentionally evading legal obligations, harming national interests, public interests, or the legitimate rights and interests of others, must be resolutely prevented and punished according to law, and acts such as forging evidence, lying in court, abusing litigation, and harassing litigation shall be seriously dealt with. By maintaining and encouraging litigation integrity, the authority of the national judiciary shall be established, and the credibility of the judiciary shall be improved.

10. Respect Autonomy of Will. Autonomy of will is a fundamental right enjoyed by civil subjects according to law and is also a basic principle that must be followed in engaging in civil activities. Autonomy of will is a concentrated manifestation of the exercise of freedom rights by civil subjects. Respect for autonomy of will is respect for the freedom rights enjoyed by civil subjects. Through adjudication and enforcement activities, the people's courts shall lead, guide, support, and protect natural persons and various social organizations in correctly exercising their autonomy of will in market economic activities and social life, strictly require various civil subjects to be responsible for their actions and consequences under the dominance of autonomy of will, and severely punish various acts of illegally interfering with others' exercise of autonomy of will. In handling relevant cases, judgments shall be made in accordance with the different effects and customary order of autonomy of will, legal provisions, transaction habits, and public order and good customs, ensuring the parties' lawful right to dispose of substantive rights and interests and the lawful right to choose procedural rights made under autonomy of will. Within the scope of adhering to strict justice and ensuring procedural fairness, parties shall be actively guided and encouraged to voluntarily choose mediation, conciliation, and other methods that reflect the parties' own dispute resolution in litigation and enforcement procedures.

11. Maintain Public Order and Good Customs. Public order and good customs are important contents of the construction of a country under the rule of law and a society under the rule of law, and are also important indicators for measuring the level of construction of socialist rule of law and rule of virtue. It is an important duty of the people's courts to advocate, cultivate, and maintain public order and good customs, and to condemn, sanction, and eliminate various immoral acts or ugly phenomena. The contemporary connotation and construction focus of public order and good customs shall be deeply understood and accurately grasped. In response to prominent existing problems such as standing by when others are in danger, failing to help when encountering difficulties, harming others for personal gain, and being unfilial and unkind, noble conducts such as "being kind to others," "valuing harmony," "tolerance and mutual concession," "respecting the elderly and loving the young," "taking pleasure in helping others," and "acting bravely for a just cause" shall be vigorously advocated. The important role of mediation, conciliation, and coordination in dispute resolution shall be fully utilized, and efforts shall be made to create a social atmosphere of mutual respect, mutual understanding, harmonious coexistence, and friendly treatment among people. Through the handling of specific cases, good social customs shall be led, so that excellent traditional Chinese culture such as valuing benevolence, emphasizing people-oriented principles, upholding integrity, advocating justice, promoting harmony, and seeking common ground can be promoted and inherited under new historical conditions, prompting morality and law to work together, and achieving the overall advancement of governing the country according to law and according to virtue.

People's courts at all levels shall base themselves on the actual work of their local and own courts, adhere to local conditions, adhere to the law as a medium, continuously innovate forms, and cultivate and practice socialist core values in a solid manner. In conjunction with carrying out the "Three Stricts and Three Honests" education and practice activities and the activity of learning from Comrade Zou Bihua, grasping ideals and beliefs as the core, grasping the world outlook, outlook on life, and values as the master switch, the cultivation and practice of socialist core values shall be carried out unswervingly, deeply, and persistently, striving for tangible results.

October 12, 2015
